item.title: Oze National Park: Skunk Cabbage & High-Altitude Wetlands from Gunma — Guide
item.description: Oze National Park, a vast high-altitude wetland straddling Gunma, Fukushima, Niigata and Tochigi prefectures, is accessible from Gunma’s Hinoemata trailheads and protected as a national park since 2007. Wooden boardwalks wind through the fragile marsh ecosystem, famous each June for spectacular blooms of white skunk cabbage (mizubasho) carpeting the wetland, followed by alpine wildflowers through summer, with Mt. Shibutsu rising above the plain and offering more demanding hiking for those wanting mountain views.
